title: Sum of Array Elements
description:
Given an array of integers, compute the sum of all its elements and print the result.

Read the number of elements followed by the elements themselves. Print the total sum.
input_format:
First line: integer n (number of elements)
Second line: n space-separated integers
output_format: A single integer representing the sum of all elements.
constraints:
1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5
-10^9 ≤ array[i] ≤ 10^9
Time Limit: 1 second
Memory Limit: 256 MB

title: Reverse a String
description:
Given a string, print it in reverse order.

Read a single line string and output its characters reversed. The input will consist only of printable ASCII characters without leading/trailing spaces.
input_format: A single line containing the string to reverse.
output_format: A single line containing the reversed string.
constraints:
1 ≤ length of string ≤ 10^5
Time Limit: 1 second
Memory Limit: 256 MB

title: Find Maximum Element
description:
Given an array of integers, find and print the maximum element.

Read the number of elements followed by the elements themselves. Print the largest value in the array.
input_format:
First line: integer n (number of elements)
Second line: n space-separated integers
output_format: A single integer representing the maximum element.
constraints:
1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5
-10^9 ≤ array[i] ≤ 10^9
Time Limit: 1 second
Memory Limit: 256 MB

title: Count Even and Odd Numbers
description:
Given an array of integers, count the number of even and odd numbers in the array.

Read the array and print two space-separated integers: the count of even numbers followed by the count of odd numbers.
input_format:
First line: integer n (number of elements)
Second line: n space-separated integers
output_format: Two space-separated integers on a single line: count of even numbers followed by count of odd numbers.
constraints:
1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5
-10^9 ≤ array[i] ≤ 10^9
Time Limit: 1 second
Memory Limit: 256 MB

title: Check Palindrome Number
description:
Given an integer, determine if it is a palindrome. A number is a palindrome if its digit sequence reads the same forwards and backwards.

Print Yes if it is a palindrome, otherwise print No.
input_format: A single line containing an integer n.
output_format: Print Yes if n is a palindrome, otherwise print No.
constraints:
0 ≤ n ≤ 10^9
Time Limit: 1 second
Memory Limit: 256 MB

title: Factorial of a Number
description:
Given a non-negative integer n, compute its factorial.

The factorial of n (denoted n!) is the product of all positive integers from 1 to n. By definition, 0! = 1.
input_format: A single line containing a non-negative integer n.
output_format: A single integer representing n!.
constraints:
0 ≤ n ≤ 20
Time Limit: 1 second
Memory Limit: 256 MB

title: Linear Search
description:
Given an array of integers and a target value, find the index (0-based) of the first occurrence of the target in the array.

If the target is not present, print -1.
input_format:
First line: integer n (number of elements)
Second line: n space-separated integers
Third line: integer target
output_format: A single integer: the 0-based index of the first occurrence of target, or -1 if not found.
constraints:
1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5
-10^9 ≤ array[i] ≤ 10^9
-10^9 ≤ target ≤ 10^9
Time Limit: 1 second
Memory Limit: 256 MB

title: Count Vowels in a String
description:
Given a string, count the number of vowels (a, e, i, o, u) in it. The check should be case-insensitive.

Print the total count of vowel characters.
input_format: A single line containing the string.
output_format: A single integer representing the count of vowels.
constraints:
1 ≤ length of string ≤ 10^5
String contains only printable ASCII characters
Time Limit: 1 second
Memory Limit: 256 MB

title: Fibonacci Sequence
description:
Given a non-negative integer n, print the first n+1 terms of the Fibonacci sequence (from index 0 to n) separated by spaces.

The Fibonacci sequence is defined as: F(0)=0, F(1)=1, F(k)=F(k-1)+F(k-2) for k≥2.
input_format: A single line containing a non-negative integer n.
output_format: A single line of n+1 space-separated integers representing F(0) through F(n).
constraints:
0 ≤ n ≤ 40
Time Limit: 1 second
Memory Limit: 256 MB

title: Sort Array in Ascending Order
description:
Given an array of integers, sort it in ascending (non-decreasing) order and print the sorted array.

Read the array, sort its elements from smallest to largest, and print them space-separated on a single line.
input_format:
First line: integer n (number of elements)
Second line: n space-separated integers
output_format: A single line of n space-separated integers in non-decreasing order.
constraints:
1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5
-10^9 ≤ array[i] ≤ 10^9
Time Limit: 1 second
Memory Limit: 256 MB

title: Two Sum
description:
Given an array of integers and a target sum, find two distinct indices i and j (i < j) such that array[i] + array[j] == target. Print the two indices separated by a space.

It is guaranteed that exactly one valid solution exists. Use 0-based indexing.
input_format:
First line: integer n (number of elements)
Second line: n space-separated integers
Third line: integer target
output_format: Two space-separated integers i and j (i < j) such that array[i] + array[j] equals target.
constraints:
2 ≤ n ≤ 10^5
-10^9 ≤ array[i] ≤ 10^9
-10^9 ≤ target ≤ 10^9
Exactly one valid pair exists
Time Limit: 1 second
Memory Limit: 256 MB

title: Longest Common Prefix
description:
Given n strings, find the longest common prefix shared by all of them.

A common prefix is a string that is a prefix of every input string. If no common prefix exists, print an empty line.

Print the longest such prefix.
input_format:
First line: integer n (number of strings)
Next n lines: one string per line
output_format: A single line containing the longest common prefix. If no common prefix exists, print an empty line.
constraints:
1 ≤ n ≤ 200
1 ≤ length of each string ≤ 200
Strings contain only lowercase English letters
Time Limit: 1 second
Memory Limit: 256 MB

title: Binary Search
description:
Given a sorted array of distinct integers and a target, find the index of the target using binary search. If not found, print -1.

The array is guaranteed to be sorted in strictly ascending order.
input_format:
First line: integer n (number of elements)
Second line: n space-separated integers in strictly ascending order
Third line: integer target
output_format: A single integer: the 0-based index of target in the array, or -1 if not present.
constraints:
1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5
-10^9 ≤ array[i] ≤ 10^9
All array elements are distinct and in strictly ascending order
Time Limit: 1 second
Memory Limit: 256 MB

title: Valid Parentheses
description:
Given a string containing only the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string has valid bracket matching.

A string is valid if every opening bracket has a corresponding closing bracket in the correct order. Print Yes if valid, otherwise No.
input_format: A single line containing the bracket string.
output_format: Print Yes if the bracket sequence is valid, otherwise print No.
constraints:
1 ≤ length of string ≤ 10^5
String contains only characters from: ( ) { } [ ]
Time Limit: 1 second
Memory Limit: 256 MB

title: Find Duplicate in Array
description:
Given an array of n+1 integers where each integer is between 1 and n inclusive, find and print the one duplicate number.

There is exactly one duplicate number in the array. The duplicate may appear more than twice.
input_format:
First line: integer n
Second line: n+1 space-separated integers, each between 1 and n inclusive
output_format: A single integer representing the duplicate number.
constraints:
1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5
1 ≤ array[i] ≤ n
Exactly one number is duplicated
Time Limit: 1 second
Memory Limit: 256 MB

title: Anagram Check
description:
Given two strings, determine if they are anagrams of each other. Two strings are anagrams if one can be rearranged to form the other (same characters with same frequencies, case-sensitive).

Print Yes if they are anagrams, otherwise print No.
input_format:
First line: string s1
Second line: string s2
output_format: Print Yes if s1 and s2 are anagrams, otherwise print No.
constraints:
1 ≤ length of s1, s2 ≤ 10^5
Strings contain only printable ASCII characters
Time Limit: 1 second
Memory Limit: 256 MB

title: Maximum Subarray Sum
description:
Given an array of integers (which may contain negative numbers), find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum and print that sum.

A subarray is a contiguous portion of the array. The array contains at least one element.
input_format:
First line: integer n (number of elements)
Second line: n space-separated integers
output_format: A single integer representing the maximum subarray sum.
constraints:
1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5
-10^4 ≤ array[i] ≤ 10^4
Time Limit: 1 second
Memory Limit: 256 MB

title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
description:
Given an array of integers, find the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.

A subsequence is a sequence derived from the array by deleting some or no elements without changing the order of the remaining elements. A strictly increasing subsequence has each element strictly greater than the previous one.
input_format:
First line: integer n (number of elements)
Second line: n space-separated integers
output_format: A single integer representing the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.
constraints:
1 ≤ n ≤ 2500
-10^4 ≤ array[i] ≤ 10^4
Time Limit: 2 seconds
Memory Limit: 256 MB

title: Number of Islands
description:
Given a grid of characters where '1' represents land and '0' represents water, count the number of islands. An island is a group of horizontally or vertically adjacent land cells ('1') surrounded by water.

Read the grid dimensions, then read the grid rows. Print the total count of distinct islands.
input_format:
First line: two space-separated integers r and c (rows and columns of grid)
Next r lines: each line contains c characters ('0' or '1') separated by spaces
output_format: A single integer representing the number of islands.
constraints:
1 ≤ r, c ≤ 50
Each cell is either '0' or '1'
Time Limit: 2 seconds
Memory Limit: 256 MB

title: Coin Change Minimum Coins
description:
Given a list of coin denominations and a target amount, find the minimum number of coins needed to make up that amount. Each coin can be used an unlimited number of times.

If the amount cannot be made up by any combination of the given coins, print -1.
input_format:
First line: integer n (number of coin denominations)
Second line: n space-separated integers representing coin values
Third line: integer amount (target sum)
output_format: A single integer representing the minimum number of coins required, or -1 if not possible.
constraints:
1 ≤ n ≤ 20
1 ≤ coin[i] ≤ 10^4
0 ≤ amount ≤ 10^4
Time Limit: 2 seconds
Memory Limit: 256 MB
